name: working_nomads-deals-mcp
description: Working Nomads (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: Single keyless JSON array (fields: url, title, description (HTML), company_name, category_name, tags, location, pub_date) with no query/page/limit parameters: `query`, `category`, `min_budget`, `page` and `limit` are not sent and the whole feed is returned; filter client-side. The feed has no id field, so `id` is the posting `url`. `tags` is a comma-separated string (not an array) and stays in `raw` with category_name and location.
